topic: RJ sediará o II Encontro Latino-Americano de Educação para as Relações Étnico-Raciais Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: The II Encontro Latino-Americano de Educação para as Relações Étnico-Raciais will be held in Rio de Janeiro, focusing on education related to ethnic-racial relations.
The event is scheduled for September 25 to 27, 2026, at the UNIRIO Campus Urca.
Registration for the event will be open from August 5 to 25, 2026.
summary: The II Encontro Latino-Americano de Educação para as Relações Étnico-Raciais is set to take place in Rio de Janeiro in September 2026, providing a platform for discussions on ethnic-racial education. Registration will be available shortly before the event, highlighting the importance of timely participation.
